notes: The crucible moves, the blocks stay: the pull stage draws the sample from the hot block through the 10 mm gap into the cold block, and the camera watches the solidification front in the gap. The cold block dumps its heat into the cold wall through a copper strap.

The catalog gives 1.52 kg for structure and containment; as an aluminium box that is a 0.49 mm skin on 0.80 kg of posts and shelves. Thin: the bay rails have to carry the launch loads, or the module needs more structure mass.
The grapple fixture stands 26 mm proud of the front panel, into the bay opening; everything else is inside the bay envelope.
